verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no rules or automation feature where a user defines triggers that run actions on events. The closest items are adjacent: turn events that a developer uses to collect transcripts, built-in barge-in behavior that cancels work when the user speaks, and Flows functions that move a conversation between nodes. These are developer building blocks or fixed framework behaviors, not user-definable event-triggered rules.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
